sql.smartlist.get: select s.*, ot.object_type from flow.smartlist s inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = s.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id
sql.smartlist.getById: select s.*, ot.object_type from flow.smartlist s inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = s.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id where s.id = :id;
sql.smartlist.update: update flow.smartlist set name = :name, company_object_type_id = :companyObjectTypeId, shared = :shared where id = :id;
sql.smartlist.getAvailableFields: select sf.id as "smartlistFieldId", null as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", sf.name as "name", null as "processStepId", null as "processStepName" from flow.smartlist_field sf inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = sf.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id where ot.id = :objectTypeId and cot.company_id = :companyId and cot.archived is not true union select null as "smartlistFieldId", cfga.id as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", cf.field_name as "name", ps.id as "processStepId", ps.process_step_name as "processStepName" from flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = cfg.company_object_type_id left join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cfg.process_step_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id where ot.id = :objectTypeId and cot.company_id = :companyId and cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id is null and cfga.archived is not true and cfg.archived is not true order by name, "processStepName";
sql.smartlist.getAssignedFields: select sfa.id, sfa.smartlist_id, sfa.smartlist_field_id, sfa.custom_field_group_assignment_id, sfa.archived, sfa.display_order, ot.object_type, case when sfa.custom_field_group_assignment_id is not null then ps.process_step_name else ps1.process_step_name end as process_step_name, case when sfa.smartlist_field_id is not null then sf.name else cf.field_name end as name from flow.smartlist_field_assignment sfa left join flow.smartlist_field sf on sf.id = sfa.smartlist_field_id left join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = sf.company_object_type_id left join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = sfa.custom_field_group_assignment_id left join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id left join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cfg.process_step_id left join flow.process_step ps1 on ps1.id = sfa.process_step_id where sfa.smartlist_id = :id and sfa.archived is not true order by sfa.display_order;
sql.smartlist.getAssignedFieldById: select sfa.id, sfa.smartlist_id, sfa.smartlist_field_id, sfa.custom_field_group_assignment_id, sfa.archived, sfa.display_order, ot.object_type, ps.process_step_name, case when sfa.custom_field_group_assignment_id is not null then ps.process_step_name else ps1.process_step_name end as process_step_name, case when sfa.smartlist_field_id is not null then sf.name else cf.field_name end as name from flow.smartlist_field_assignment sfa left join flow.smartlist_field sf on sf.id = sfa.smartlist_field_id left join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = sf.company_object_type_id left join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = sfa.custom_field_group_assignment_id left join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id left join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cfg.process_step_id left join flow.process_step ps1 on ps1.id = sfa.process_step_id where sfa.id = :id and sfa.archived is not true;
sql.smartlist.deleteField: update flow.smartlist_field_assignment set archived = true, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id;
sql.smartlist.updateDisplayOrder: update flow.smartlist_field_assignment set display_order = :displayOrder, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id;
